keypoints.name: Stick controls
keypoints.description: Explains the function of the left and right sticks on the FPV drone controller, specifically throttle/yaw and pitch/roll.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Covered in dedicated section and repeated a few times, though not returned to.
representative_quotes: So, on the left-hand side right here, we have a stick that centers in the middle, but it'll stay wherever you put it.
On the other side of our controller, we have our pitch and roll stick.

keypoints.name: Flight modes
keypoints.description: Details two primary flight modes: angle mode (self-leveling) and acro mode (rate mode). Describes the differences in how the sticks control the drone's movement in each mode.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Dedicated section with multiple mentions, and compared at length.
representative_quotes: Angle mode is the easiest for people to learn. I always start people off by teaching them angle mode.

Instead of correlating the position of your stick with the angle of the drone, acro mode correlates the position of your stick with the speed to rotate the drone at, in that direction that your stick is in.

keypoints.name: Flying in Angle Mode
keypoints.description: Presents a 3-step method for new FPV pilots learning to fly in angle mode, beginning with throttle control and hovering.
keypoints.strength_reasoning: Introduced, developed in a dedicated section, and returned to to reinforce each step.
representative_quotes: First step is just to hover your drone.
The next step we're going to do is incorporate our yaw.
